verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for an AI assistant or model product, so the axis applies. Nothing in the pack shows Claude itself can be deployed on user infrastructure. The desktop app install, local MCP servers and data-residency controls only cover client installs, connecting extensions, or choosing where Anthropic processes data, not self-hosting the core product.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
